# Academy For Sports Dentistry

> Professional organization advancing sports dentistry through certification, education, and leadership for dental care of athletes.

The Academy for Sports Dentistry (ASD) is a premier professional organization dedicated to sports dentistry practice and athlete care. The organization provides certification programs, continuing education, networking opportunities, and position statements to advance the field of sports dentistry globally.

## Key Topics

- Sports Dentistry
- ASD Certified Team Dentist
- Team Dentist Certification
- Symposium 2026
- Dental Traumatology
- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Athlete Care
- ASD Team Dentist Course
- Bridging the Gap
- Digital Full-Arch Dentistry
- Membership
- Leadership
- Networking
- Professional Organization

## Certification & Professional Services

- [Become A Certified ASD Team Dentist](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/be-a-certified-team-dentist): ASD Team Dentist certification program and requirements
- [Find an ASD Certified Team Dentist](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/find-a-certified-team-dentist): Directory to find ASD Certified Team Dentist professionals
- [Find A Dentist | Sports Dentist Search](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/find-a-sports-dentist): Search directory for ASD certified sports dentist professionals

## Events & Professional Development

- [Symposium 2026](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/symposium-2026): ASD Symposium 2026 conference and professional development event
- [Pre-Symposium Workshops](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/pre-symposium-workshops): Pre-Symposium continuing education workshops for dentists
- [Pre-symposium](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/pre-symposium): Pre-Symposium workshops and ASD Team Dentist Course details
- [Bridging the Gap 2026](https://www.academyforsportsdentistry.org/bridging-the-gap): Bridging the Gap 2026 pre-symposium workshop on performance
